x: At 7.p.m. on Saturday 19th May, the R.R.C. team of John Smith, Don Turner, Tom Buckingham and myself, boarded a B.O.A.C. Comet 4 which was to take us to Johannesburg in some 18 hours.

…ak came sooner than expected when the R.R.C. announced it was launching an appeal to send Ron Linstead, Tom Buckingham, John Smith and Don Turner to the 1962 "Comrades Marathon" (Durban to Pietermaritzburg, 54 miles).…

Lewis was anchoring for Santa Monica in their world record breaking run of 1:18.68 but John, running for John Smith's All-Star team which included Drummond, Jarrett and Mitchell, closed dramatically on that last stage and brought his team home also inside the old figures.
